name: Bishop Jane
source:
The Bishop in charge of overseeing the Church of [url=/c171800]Luminox[/url] in the capital. Many people adore Jane. That group of people does not include [url=/c171507]Bishop Mara[/url]. Mara is looking for a way to demote her and promote [url=/c171508]Selena[/url] as the next Bishop of the capital, but the red tape within the order holds her back. She is seen as incompetent by her peers and easily pushed over by [url=/c171585]the Chancellor[/url].
